profile.name: Kanchan Nath
profile.headline: Full-Stack Engineer & Backend Specialist | Founder @ StudeQ
profile.summary: Full-stack engineer and backend specialist pursuing B.Tech in Biotechnology at NIT Durgapur (CGPA 9.04). Experienced in designing high-concurrency Node.js/Express architectures, Redis caching & BullMQ pipelines, microservices, and AI-assisted educational tools. Founder of StudeQ (100+ users). Skilled in AI model training, prompt evaluation, and technical writing.
profile.status: Building scalable backend systems, AI agents, and full-stack web applications.

preferences.coding_style: Production-ready, highly modular, strict validation (Zod), clear separation of concerns (controller-service-repository), robust error handling and structured logging.
preferences.agent_instruction: Whenever helping me write code, tailor solutions to high-performance Node.js / TypeScript / Python backend patterns. Include proper input validation, logging, and async queue/caching considerations when relevant.

ai_and_llms: LLM Model Training & Evaluation (RLHF, Accuracy, Logic, Safety)
system_architecture: Reverse Proxy & API Gateway (TLS termination, load balancing)
Payment Gateway Integration (Razorpay with Webhook Verification)

projects.name: StudeQ
projects.summary: AI-backed full-stack study platform for students featuring intelligent note taking, automated quizzes, flashcards, and PDF-based chat. Serves over 100 active users.
highlights: Developed full stack with end-to-end ownership: Next.js/React frontend, Node.js/Express backend, and cloud deployment on Render.
Designed secure REST APIs with JWT authentication, cookie management, and Zod input validation.
Built background job queue with Redis and BullMQ for document processing and AI workloads.
Integrated Razorpay payment gateway with verified webhooks and managed SEO and organic growth.

projects.name: Nexus - Zero-Dependency Reverse Proxy & API Gateway
projects.summary: Production-grade reverse proxy and API gateway built strictly using Node.js standard library (`node:*` built-ins) without any third-party npm dependencies.
highlights: Implemented TLS termination, dynamic path routing, health checks, round-robin load balancing, and rate limiting with zero external dependencies.
Built a live metrics dashboard and authentication verification layer directly in native Node.js streams.
Documented architectural design and performance characteristics in featured Hashnode article.

projects.name: YouTube-like Scalable Backend System
projects.summary: Highly scalable video platform backend supporting video upload, transcoding, streaming schemas, and real-time user engagement.
highlights: Engineered asynchronous video processing pipeline with BullMQ + FFmpeg for automatic multi-resolution transcoding (240p to 1080p).
Implemented access and refresh token JWT authentication, video metadata caching with Redis, and live-streaming database collections.
Refactored architecture from monolith towards modular microservices to optimize independent service scaling.

projects.name: Content Automation Pipeline
projects.summary: Autonomous publishing pipeline that extracts code changes from GitHub, performs analysis via Groq LLM API, and publishes technical articles to Hashnode and Dev.to.
highlights: Automated code review extraction and blog draft generation on a scheduled cron cadence.
Enabled cross-platform publishing with automated tag and markdown formatting.

projects.name: ScanBeforeEat
projects.summary: Mobile-first Progressive Web App (PWA) that decodes complex food ingredient labels into clear, evidence-based consumer health intelligence.
highlights: Translates cryptic food additives and chemical codes into intuitive health insights.
Designed mobile-first with offline PWA support.

projects.name: Now_Myself (Know Myself Context Hub)
projects.summary: Single source of truth multi-agent context hub and MCP server connecting personal developer background, skills, and weekly updates across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Antigravity.
highlights: Exposes FastMCP tools and REST API endpoints for seamless LLM integration.
Automated compilation of llms.txt and single-prompt profile context.

experience.description: Built and scaled an AI-powered study platform for 100+ active student users with full architectural and operational ownership.
achievements: Engineered frontend in React/Next.js and resilient REST backend in Node.js/Express.
Integrated dual database layer (PostgreSQL with Prisma, MongoDB with Mongoose) and background queuing with Redis/BullMQ.
Implemented Razorpay payment flows with secure webhook signatures, growing organic traffic through targeted technical SEO.

experience.description: Trained and evaluated generative LLM models across coding, logical reasoning, and factual precision domains.
achievements: Evaluated model outputs by creating, ranking, and annotating prompt-response pairs according to strict accuracy and safety protocols.
Identified and flagged logical edge-case failures and hallucinations in code generation outputs.
Collaborated with distributed AI training cohorts under strict quality and turnaround deadlines.
